concepts.name: Unit 9|Indigenous Knowledge And Heritage
concepts.simple_definition: Unit 9|Indigenous Knowledge and Heritages of Ethiopia 211 9.1 Indigenous Knowledge Learning outcomes of the lesson At the end of this lesson, the students will be able to: • identify the essence of indigenous knowledge; • appreciate the role of indigenous knowledge in development
concepts.deep_explanation: • What do you know about indigenous knowledge? • Do you think that indigenous knowledge is significant to sustainable development? If yes/ no, how? Brainstorming Indigenous knowledge is the knowledge that assists society in making judgments regarding activities that are compatible with their way of life

concepts.simple_definition: History Grade 10 Student Textbook 216 Figure 9.2 Jaarsuummaa of the Oromo people Gumaa is the other widely practised indigenous way of resolving conflicts relating to homicide or murder
